title: Late-Posting Clock for Special Order Refunds Credited to Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
**Rule.** The late-posting days of a return credit to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account are the calendar days from the day the late-posting clock starts to today. Where the clock starts is read from the customer's Ridgeline Special Order Services ledger, by comparing the refunds it issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the last 3 months (dated less than 3 full months before today) with the credits the special order program applied in the same 3 months:

1. **Payout of vendor-delay credits.** When the refunds to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the 3 months are the payout of vendor-delay credits — that is, the vendor-delay credits the special order program applied in the same 3 months total exactly the same amount as those refunds — the clock starts on the latest of those delay-credit dates.
2. **Payout of order-cancellation credits.** When that does not hold but the order-cancellation credits applied in the same 3 months total exactly the same amount as those refunds, the clock starts on the latest of those cancellation-credit dates.
3. **Otherwise** the clock starts on the latest refund date.

A match requires at least one credit of that kind in the 3 months, totalling to the cent the same amount as the refunds.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical special order ledgers)

| Refunds to the card tender in 3 months | Vendor-delay credits in 3 months | Order-cancellation credits in 3 months | Clock starts on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 650.00 | 650.00 (dated 2 April and 9 April) | 0.00 | 9 April, the latest delay-credit date |
| 650.00 | 650.00 | 650.00 | the latest delay-credit date (the first rule holds) |
| 650.00 | 300.00 | 650.00 (dated 14 April) | 14 April, the latest cancellation-credit date |
| 650.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 | the latest refund date |
| 650.00 | 649.99 | 0.00 | the latest refund date (not exactly the same amount) |

**Counting the days (hypothetical).** A clock starting on 9 April and today 21 May: 42 calendar days.

The records read are the entries of the customer's Ridgeline Special Order Services orders: refunds issued with the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender as refund method, and credits applied to the orders, each with its credit type (vendor delay or order cancellation), amount and date.
